Marathón|Marathón]] | league topscorer = [[Erick Puerto]] (16 goals){{cite web |url=https://www.diez.hn/liganacionaldehonduras/goleadores-liga-nacional-honduras-yio-puerto-messiniti-competencia-GM28530116 |title=Goleadores de Liga Nacional de Honduras: Yio Puerto y Messiniti tienen competencia |work=Diario Diez |date=2025-12-06 |access-date=2026-07-16}} | total goals = 345 | matches = 110 | prevseason = [[2024–25 Honduran Liga Nacional|2024–25]] | nextseason = [[2026–27 Honduran Liga Nacional|2026–27]] | updated = }} The '''2025–26 Honduran Liga Nacional''' season is the 60th edition of the [[Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras]] since its establishment in 1965. The season is split into two separate tournaments: the Apertura, which took place from July 2025 to January 2026, and the Clausura, which commenced on 24 January 2026. [[C.D. Olimpia|Olimpia]] entered the season as the defending champions and successfully secured the Apertura 2025 title on 7 January 2026, defeating [[C.D. Marathón|Marathón]] with a 3–2 aggregate score in the final (2–2 in the first leg, 1–0 in the second leg).{{cite news |url=https://proceso.hn/1-0-olimpia-vence-por-la-minima-al-marathon-y-ogra-su-40o-titulo-de-liga-nacional/ |title=1-0. Olimpia vence al Marathón y suma su copa 40 de la Liga Nacional |work=Proceso Digital |date=2026-01-07 |access-date=2026-07-16}}{{cite news |url=https://elmundo.hn/olimpia-se-corona-campeon-del-apertura-2025/ |title=Olimpia se corona campeón del Apertura 2025 |work=Diario El Mundo |date=2026-01-07 |access-date=2026-07-16}} This marked Olimpia's 40th league title, tying [[Deportivo Saprissa]] of Costa Rica for the most domestic league championships in Central America.{{cite web |url=https://www.lnphn.com/2026/07/03/que-tanto-conoces-al-primer-finalista-de-la-supercopa-hondubet/ |title=¿Qué tanto conoces al primer finalista de la Supercopa Hondubet? |publisher=Liga Hondubet |date=2026-07-03 |access-date=2026-07-16}} By winning the Apertura, Olimpia became the first Honduran club to qualify for the [[2026 CONCACAF Central American Cup]], as confirmed by Concacaf.{{cite web |url=https://www.concacaf.com/competitions/central-american-cup/news/key-details-and-qualified-teams-for-2026-central-american-cup |title=Qualified Teams for 2026 Central American Cup |publisher=CONCACAF |date=2026-05-23 |access-date=2026-07-16}} The remaining two berths for the international competition, as well as the team to be relegated to the [[Liga de Ascenso de Honduras|Liga de Ascenso]], will be determined by the results of the Clausura tournament and the final aggregate table.{{cite news |url=https://www.laprensa.hn/deportes/olimpia-equipos-de-honduras-clasificados-copa-centroamericana-2025-26-FL25482623 |title=La noticia internacional que alegra al Olimpia en plena mala racha de la Liga Nacional |work=La Prensa |date=2025-04-22 |access-date=2026-07-16}} ==Teams== {{Location map+| Honduras | width=400 | float = | caption = Location of teams in 2024–25 season |places= {{Location map~| Honduras | lat = 14.45 | long = -87.66 | label = [[Polícia Nacional FC|Polícia Nacional]] | position=top}} {{Location map~| Honduras | lat = 14.65857 | long = -86.2163 | label = [[Juticalpa F.C.|Juticalpa]] | position=top}} {{Location map~| Honduras | lat = 15.47 | long = -88.00 | label = [[C.D.
